scientific_integrity: The original raised-simplex construction and its k<n behavior are credited to van Hintum (2026); the general Schneider-index upper bound is credited to FMMZ (2018). The contribution is the exact matching lower bound for all k and simultaneous equality profile.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean metric; unit-circumradius regular simplex; 0<epsilon<1/(n-1)^2 is sufficient but not optimality-certified. No universal best constant claimed; unindexed equivalent literature is possible.
title: Exact all-order Hausdorff convexification profile of a raised-simplex set
